resources.string: A quieter Home screen. A few essential apps. A little intention before you leave.

Focus Harbor is a reversible Home app, not a device lock.

Normal exit: tap Leave focus. If you enabled the word challenge before this session, write any text with at least 10 words and tap End focus. There is no preset to match, and your text is not saved. Otherwise the session ends immediately.

Recovery: open Android Settings from the notification shade. Find Apps > Default apps > Home app, then choose your previous launcher. Names vary by phone. You can also uninstall Focus Harbor or clear its app storage from Android Settings; this removes its saved session.

Phone: this app only opens your dialer. It never places a call. If no dialer is available, use the lock-screen Emergency call option if supported. Never test an emergency number.

No root, administrator access, accessibility service, overlay, VPN, app disabling, or system-wide blocking is used. Work and private profiles are not managed.
